TITLE: Silence Rest Pose
DESCRIPTION: Internal renderer-test archetype (NOT a shipped library scene). A calm idle breathing field that must present a clean, sane rest pose at zero audio (RMS=peak=0, FFT all 0, syn_BPM=120) rather than an all-black or NaN frame. Covers the SILENCE edge case: the render path may feed silence, so the neutral look is driven by TIME alone while all four wired audio uniforms (chroma_AudioRMS, chroma_AudioPeak, chroma_AudioFFT[8], syn_BPM) add visible motion only when present.
